suites.observable_behavior: Offline installability, declared and actually imported dependencies, and the documented import names, observed only through setup.sh, installed distribution metadata and Python imports.
suites.case_design: Copy the candidate into a fresh writable directory in the pinned offline image (network none, PIP_NO_INDEX=1) and run its real setup.sh once in a fresh virtual environment; every case in the suite uses that install, so a failed install fails all five ids. Import probes run from an empty working directory so the source checkout cannot shadow the editable install. Dependency checks read Requires-Dist and compare sys.modules after importing each pycparser module against sys.stdlib_module_names. R01.01 lexes, parses and generates one small function end to end.

suites.observable_behavior: Which declaration snippets CParser.parse accepts and the shape of the resulting declaration subtrees (node classes, attr_names values, children() names), plus Coord.file/line for the filename argument.
suites.case_design: Each case calls CParser().parse on the authored snippet and asserts the documented subtree with a small path helper that walks children() by name and reads attr_names values; it never touches private attributes. Unspecified points recorded as gaps (ext grouping, K&R identifier list, designator node class) are not asserted.

suites.observable_behavior: Expression precedence/associativity shapes, statement node kinds, and the documented leaf strings of operator, StructRef, Constant and call/parameter-list nodes.
suites.case_design: Snippets are wrapped in a function body where needed and parsed; cases locate the target statement by index in the body Compound and compare node classes and leaf values. Constant cases assert value text and type only for the suffixes the instruction names.

suites.observable_behavior: The c_ast.Node contract: base class, coord, children() tuple and indexed names, attr_names, show() options, iteration, mutability, the 49 node classes with __slots__, constructor parameter order and keyword-only coord, and JSON export and generation from programmatically built trees.
suites.case_design: Table cases construct every node class positionally and by keyword with sentinel values and compare attributes, children() names and attr_names against the instruction table. show() output is captured in io.StringIO and checked only for the substrings the instruction fixes. The JSON walker and the structural-equality helper (node class, attr_names values, children() names, coord ignored) are checker code written from the public contract. Generator-dependent cases call CGenerator().visit and re-parse.

suites.observable_behavior: Leaf-value and attachment conventions for declarations: unsized array dims, struct body states and bit-fields, TypeDecl interposition, qualifier/storage/funcspec lists and their placement, Pragma.string forms and Alignas capture.
suites.case_design: Each case parses its snippet and asserts the documented attachment point (Decl vs TypeDecl vs PtrDecl/ArrayDecl, None vs [] vs list). Cases needing re-emission (R05.24, R05.26) generate with CGenerator and re-parse. Membership is checked with 'in' where the instruction says 'contains', so positions the text leaves open (gaps) do not fail a conforming candidate.

suites.observable_behavior: CLexer construction, token stream and token type names, the type_lookup_func hook, '$' identifiers, #line handling and Coord attributes/str form.
suites.case_design: Lexer cases build CLexer with recording callbacks (error_func, on_lbrace_func, on_rbrace_func, type_lookup_func), call input() then token() until None, and compare (type, value, lineno) tuples; column is only checked for presence. Coord cases parse with an explicit filename and compare file, line and str(coord) conditioned on whether column is set.

suites.observable_behavior: NodeVisitor dispatch and recursion rules, CGenerator text output in both parenthesization modes, and parse -> generate -> re-parse equality.
suites.case_design: Visitor cases subclass c_ast.NodeVisitor with recording visit_ methods and compare the recorded sequence. Generator cases assert exact statement substrings the instruction fixes and, for round trips, re-parse the output in both modes and compare with the structural-equality helper (coord ignored).

suites.observable_behavior: ParseError raising for structural mistakes and illegal specifier combinations, and its 'file:line: description' message prefix.
suites.case_design: Each snippet is parsed with filename='bad.c' inside pytest.raises-style handling that requires pycparser.c_parser.ParseError specifically; the message is checked for the 'bad.c:<line>: ' prefix and a non-empty description. Legal multi-word specifiers are parsed in the same suite as positive controls.

normal_control.description: A minimal pycparser package authored only from instruction.md: pyproject.toml with no runtime dependencies, an offline editable-install setup.sh, and pycparser/__init__.py, c_lexer.py, c_parser.py, c_ast.py and c_generator.py implementing the import surface, the 49 node classes with the tabled constructor order, keyword-only coord, children()/attr_names/show()/iteration, Coord, ParseError, CLexer/Token with the listed token names and lookup hook, a recursive-descent parser covering exactly the grammar exercised by the authored cases (declarations including K&R, specifiers/qualifiers, declarators, struct/union/enum, initializers, compound literals, expressions, statements, C11 keywords, VLAs, #line, '$' identifiers, scoped typedefs, illegal specifier rejection), the documented leaf conventions, NodeVisitor, and CGenerator with both parenthesization modes. Every case must pass against it. It exists to validate the checkers and the defective controls; it never certifies a candidate and is not derived from, or compared with, upstream pycparser source or tests.

defective_controls.mutation: setup.sh installs with build isolation and an index URL, so the offline build cannot fetch its backend and the install fails.
pycparser/__init__.py no longer imports CParser from c_parser.
c_parser.py adds a top-level 'import ply.yacc' that is absent from the image.
parse() ignores its filename argument and always stamps '<unknown>' into Coord.file.
K&R parameter declarations are consumed but FuncDef.param_decls is left None.
IdentifierType.names is sorted alphabetically instead of kept in source order.
A struct member without a declarator raises ParseError.
Designators are skipped, so '.y = 2' becomes a plain Constant in the InitList instead of a NamedInitializer.
_Static_assert, _Alignas and _Noreturn are lexed as ordinary identifiers.
A non-constant array dimension or a qualifier inside array brackets raises ParseError.
A lone ';' at file scope raises ParseError.
Typedef names are global and never shadowed, so 'int T = 3;' inside a block fails to parse.
All binary operators share one precedence level, left-associative.
do-while statements are built as While nodes.
Assignment.op stores '+' for '+=' (the trailing '=' is dropped).
Postfix increment/decrement store '++'/'--' instead of 'p++'/'p--'.
StructRef.type is '.' for both '.' and '->'.
Constant.type ignores literal suffixes ('10u' gives 'int', '2.5f' gives 'double').
'()' yields an empty ParamList and 'foo()' an empty ExprList instead of None.
The comma operator is built as BinaryOp ',' instead of ExprList.
The parser stores coord as a (file, line) tuple instead of a Coord.
children() names list elements 'ext' and 'block_items' without the [i] index.
attr_names lists starred child names as well as leaf names.
show(nodenames=True) omits child names such as 'ext[0]'.
Node defines no __iter__.
Node.__setattr__ raises AttributeError once construction has finished.
CGenerator formats node.coord unconditionally and crashes on coord None.
c_ast lacks EmptyStatement and Alignas, and other classes omit __slots__.
coord becomes a trailing positional parameter and Decl's storage/align parameters swap order.
An unsized or flexible array gets dim Constant '0' instead of None.
Forward 'struct S;' gets decls [] instead of None.
Standalone struct/union/enum declarations wrap the type in TypeDecl(declname=None).
Decl.storage and funcspec hold a single str instead of a list.
The _Pragma payload Constant value has its surrounding quotes stripped.
Decl.align holds plain strings and the generator omits _Alignas.
The _Atomic(...) specifier form contributes no '_Atomic' qualifier.
A trailing '_Atomic' after the base type is recorded nowhere on TypeDecl.quals.
Leading const/volatile on a pointer or array declaration go to PtrDecl.quals / ArrayDecl.dim_quals.
#line directives are skipped without updating file or line.
'$' is accepted only after the first identifier character.
str(Coord) always appends ':<column>', yielding 'c.c:1:None' when unset.
Token objects lack the column attribute.
Binary integers lex as INT_CONST_DEC and hex floats as FLOAT_CONST.
The lexer never calls type_lookup_func and always emits ID.
generic_visit returns without visiting children.
visit() calls generic_visit after every visit_XXX method.
The generator emits operators and '=' without surrounding spaces.
The default mode behaves like reduce_parentheses=True.
reduce_parentheses=True removes every parenthesis, including required ones.
Nested unary minus is emitted as '--x', which re-parses as a decrement.
ParseError messages omit the 'file:line: ' prefix.
Repeated or conflicting base specifiers accumulate into IdentifierType.names.
parse() returns None instead of raising on a syntax error.
